# shibumi-server

> Small deployment service for exact locally built images on a Linux VPS using rootless Podman Compose, Caddy, and systemd.

Canonical site: https://server.shibumistack.dev
Source: https://github.com/bitbonsai/shibumi-server

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](/docs/index.md): installation path and documentation map.
- [Install shibumi-server](/docs/install.md): host requirements, installer, verification, and updates.
- [Add an app](/docs/add-app.md): server-side registration and dry run.
- [Connect project](/docs/ship.md): project-owned Ship setup and local prebuilt deployment.
- [Deployments](/docs/deployments.md): client and server pipelines, checks, health, and resource defaults.
- [History and rollback](/docs/history-rollback.md): bounded records and 12-hour rollback retention.
- [Environment and secrets](/docs/app-env.md): per-app runtime values via ship:env and shis env, injected at deploy.
- [Operations](/docs/operations.md): status, updates, removal, uninstall, and service logs.
- [Security model](/docs/security.md): webhook, secret, image, Caddy, and resource trust boundaries.
- [Command reference](/docs/commands.md): `shis` commands and options.
- [Architecture](/docs/architecture.md): full request, checkout, image, cutover, and installation design.
- [Prebuilt benchmark](/docs/prebuilt-benchmark.md): measured pilot results and caveats.
